config.campaign: C05 checked ORF, 20 primary + 16 coherence + 20 auto + 2 HD zeros
config.acceptance: Every check must satisfy absolute <=atol; when |Gamma|>near_zero_magnitude also relative <=rtol. The wrapper additionally applies its own atol+rtol*|Gamma| criterion.
config.coarse_provenance: All 20 primary and 16 coherence resolutions preserve the historical scripts. Auto cases reuse primary resolutions. HD-zero direct coarse grids preserve 720x1440; harmonic coarse 500x1200 is added explicitly.
notes: Each case uses checked_orf. Raw numerical functions are used only for independent auto references and additional Earth-only direct HD-zero checks.
Bounds are empirical refinement controls and do not certify every point inside the phase envelope.
Timings include whatever quadrature-node cache is warm at that point in the ordered campaign.
